title: NIM Agency Development
description: The agency itself: dogfood project tracking the open threads from MANIFEST KNOWN GAPS. Steered by editing this project between cycles.

responsibilities: Objective 3 ONLY this cycle: produce the tui/builder.py split plan - proposed module boundaries with line ranges, extraction order (safest first), cross-module dependencies to break, and a risk list. Deliver it as a concrete plan the operator can execute mechanically.
Do not attempt other objectives; reference them only where the split affects them

objectives.text: Stand up a test suite (no tests exist today)
Declare dependencies: core is stdlib; asyncssh, cryptography, jsonschema optional
Build key distribution and revocation flows (vault issuance only today)
Feed mission outcomes into achievements (economy is wired, achievements are not)
Add a TUI reattach view for backgrounded dispatch runs
Make mission show -v render dispatch-time prompts, not recomposed state
Rename one of the twin ops_log.py modules (dispatch lifecycle vs HQ remote-ops)
Guard TUI text inputs against paste floods (role_title label corruption incident: terminal scrollback pasted into a curses field)
Engagement quality review flow: rate quality_score on release/complete, pay a review bonus, surface it in the dossier
Foundry support for capability rows (structured proficiency/xp-cost data needs a richer form than the flat field list)

directives: Keep every state-changing command observable - explicit ceremonies over silent side effects
Keep the briefing gate in front of anything that spawns agent work
